jobs.occupation: Specialist/Consultant in Neurology looking for job opportunities in Denmark?
jobs.description:
Specialist/Consultant in Neurology looking for job opportunities in Denmark?

Newly Created Position at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital for an Emergency Neurology Profile in Partnership with Rigshospitalet, The University Hospital of Copenhagen.

We are expanding our team of specialists at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital, Denmark as we develop a new emergency neurology profile. You will have a direct professional influence on our future emergency services and become part of a new, close partnership with Rigshospitalet.

Why choose us?

• Help shape the emergency services of the future: You will play a central role in developing and launching our upcoming emergency neurology profile (without a thrombolysis service).

• New partnership with Rigshospitalet: The collaboration will open opportunities for professional exchange, knowledge sharing and research. For those interested, there will also be opportunities for attractive split appointments (e.g. one day per week at Rigshospitalet).

• New professional opportunities from 1 January 2027: As a result of the healthcare reform in Denmark, we will take over specialised rehabilitation from the municipalities, creating exciting opportunities for professional development.

• Scope for your subspecialty: Whether your interests lie in MS, movement disorders, headache, dementia, epilepsy or rehabilitation, we will adapt the framework to allow you to pursue your area of expertise.

• A strong research environment: We focus on patients with multimorbidity and have our own Professor of Neurology. Research is primarily focused on multiple sclerosis.

Your profile

You are a specialist/consultant in neurology, whether you are newly qualified and eager to develop your skills or an experienced colleague looking for a new professional setting.

We imagine that you:

• Are passionate about multidisciplinary collaboration and want to help shape the quality of the new emergency setup.

• Value a strong professional network across hospitals.

• Appreciate the opportunity to provide clinical guidance and supervision to our junior doctors.

• Are decisive, flexible and actively contribute to our positive working environment and pioneering spirit.

Your working day and responsibilities

Our department provides primary-level neurological services in the hospital at Slagelse (inpatient ward for phase II rehabilitation, primarily for apoplexy cases, as well as specialist clinics), and in the hospital of Naestved, where we run the Centre for Neurorehabilitation (CNN), which provides services at regional level.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Working in our outpatient department, specialist clinics or the interdisciplinary Memory Clinic, in collaboration with geriatricians, psychiatrists and neuropsychologists.

• Supervising junior doctors and participating in the multidisciplinary environment across our hospital sites.

• On-call duties: Our consultants currently cover the senior on-call function on site until 9.00 pm, followed by an on-call-from-home arrangement (there is junior on-call doctor is present on site around the clock).

About the department

Neurology is part of a combined department (Medicine 3 and Department of Physio- and Occupational Therapy) that works closely and efficiently alongside the Department of Geriatrics. We place a strong emphasis on professional dialogue and peer support within a group of doctors characterised by strong collegial relationships and a shared desire to develop the specialty.

Mid- and West Zealand Hospital is located around 60 min. by car from central Copenhagen.

Practical information and application

• The seven medical roles: Your application should address the seven medical competencies specifically, supported by the best possible documentation.

• Interests: If you have specific wishes regarding subspecialisation or are interested in a split appointment with Rigshospitalet, we would be pleased if you mention this in your application.

Relocation Assistance and Danish Language Tutoring

When you relocate to Denmark in connection with your employment, we offer free, professional assistance with relocation and settling in, either close to the hospital or anywhere on Zealand you might prefer. You will receive help with everything from finding accommodation to registration and arrangements for any accompanying family members.

An important part of working as a doctor in Denmark is communication between you and your patients and colleagues. For patient safety reasons, Region Zealand therefore requires our doctors to have a satisfactory level of Danish language proficiency. We therefore provide a language teacher for one-to-one tuition, enabling you to communicate with your patients as quickly as possible at a level where you can understand one another.

This means, that we expect you to be prepared to devote time to learning Danish, both spoken and written as part of your employment.

Find out more about what kind of assistance we offer, as well as watch interviews with other doctors that have relocated to Region Zealand at www.medicaljobsdenmark.com.

Would you like to know more?

You are very welcome to contact Chief Physician Benedikte Wanscher on mobile +45 93 57 62 51 or by email at bewa@regionsjaelland.dk for an informal and confidential conversation about the position.

Please upload your application and CV as soon as possible. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.

Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

jobs.occupation: Creative Buffet Chef – Winter Season 2026/2027
jobs.description:
Do you love preparing delicious prepared food, colourful salads and beautifully presented buffet dishes? Would you enjoy spending the winter in the Norwegian mountains?

Lillehammer Fjellstue is a small, family-run mountain lodge located at Nordseter, just 15 minutes from Lillehammer, Norway.

We are looking for a creative, independent and reliable chef to join our friendly international team for the winter season, starting in late December 2026.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys cooking, takes pride in preparing good food and appreciates working in a small, well-established team.

Our kitchen and food philosophy

At Lillehammer Fjellstue, we believe that good food doesn't have to be complicated.

Every morning, we serve a traditional Norwegian breakfast buffet with a selection of cold dishes.

In the evening, our guests enjoy a dinner buffet featuring a hot fish dish, a hot meat dish, soup, vegetarian options, fresh salads, cold fish and meat selections, and the dessert of the day.

We are not a large hotel with an extensive buffet selection. Instead, we focus on good good food, fresh ingredients, variety, attractive presentation and dishes our guests genuinely enjoy.

We value teamwork, mutual respect and a positive working atmosphere. Our chefs have clearly defined responsibilities but help each other whenever needed.

Your main responsibilities

Your primary responsibility will be preparing and presenting the cold section of our daily dinner buffet, including:

• 

Preparing and beautifully arranging platters with cold fish, meat and other savoury selections.

• 

Creating fresh, colourful salads, vegetable dishes and homemade dressings.

• 

Preparing homemade vegetarian pies, occasional pizzas and other simple vegetarian dishes.

• 

Preparing and arranging the cold breakfast buffet for the following morning.

• 

Presenting and replenishing the evening buffet during service.

• 

Planning daily preparations and food quantities according to guest numbers.

• 

Maintaining excellent food hygiene, safe food handling and a clean, organised kitchen.

We are flexible in how we divide responsibilities between our chefs.

Who are we looking for?

We would love to hear from someone who:

• 

Has relevant experience from a professional kitchen, restaurant, hotel or catering business.

• 

Enjoys preparing cold dishes, salads, vegetables and vegetarian food.

• 

Has a good eye for presentation and takes pride in making food both tasty and attractive.

• 

Can work independently, plan ahead and take responsibility for their own kitchen section.

• 

Has good knowledge of food hygiene, food safety and allergen management.

• 

Communicates well in English.

• 

Is reliable, flexible and enjoys working as part of a small team.

• 

Respects different working styles and appreciates a friendly, supportive working environment.

Formal culinary education is an advantage, but practical experience, reliability and a genuine passion for cooking are just as important to us. Experience from smaller restaurants, guesthouses or cafés would be very valuable.

Working hours and winter lifestyle

Working hours are mainly in the afternoon and evening.

We offer flexibility when organising shifts, and split shifts may be possible for those who would like to enjoy cross-country skiing or other outdoor activities during the day.

Nordseter is a beautiful and peaceful mountain destination, with excellent cross-country skiing trails and winter scenery right outside the door.

What we offer

• 

Full-time seasonal employment from late December 2026 until the end of March / beginning of April 2027.

• 

Free staff accommodation with your own private bedroom, and shared kitchen and living areas (6 people sharing)

• 

A friendly, international team with several long-standing employees.

• 

A small, family-run workplace with a personal and welcoming atmosphere.

• 

A well-organised kitchen with established routines and clear responsibilities.

• 

The opportunity to contribute your own ideas and cooking skills within our food concept.

• 

Beautiful mountain surroundings and excellent opportunities for cross-country skiing and outdoor activities.

How to apply

We would love to hear about your kitchen experience and why you would like to spend the winter working with us!

To be considered for the position, please send:

• 

Your CV.

• 

A personal motivation letter explaining why you would like to work at Lillehammer Fjellstue.

• 

Work certificates from previous employers and contact details for references.

• 

A short description of your experience with cold buffets, salads, vegetarian cooking and food presentation.

Photos of dishes you have prepared yourself are also very welcome!

Send your application to: jobs@lillehammerfjellstue.no

Learn more about our mountain lodge at www.lillehammerfjellstue.no.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Warm regards,

Bente & the team at Lillehammer Fjellstue

Om arbeidsgiveren:
About Lillehammer Fjellstue

Lillehammer Fjellstue is a traditional, family-run mountain lodge offering hotel rooms, cabins and holiday apartments at Nordseter, approximately 15 minutes from Lillehammer.

Located in one of Norway's popular cross-country skiing areas, we welcome guests from Norway and abroad who come to enjoy beautiful mountain surroundings, winter activities, good food and a relaxed, friendly atmosphere.

jobs.occupation: Sous Chef at Lovund Hotel – Help shape the flavours of the Helgeland Coast
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about food and creating exceptional guest experiences? Do you want to help develop and shape the culinary identity of one of Norway’s most unique hotels? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Hva vi ser etter

We are looking for someone who is passionate about great flavours, respects ingredients and wants to develop both people and culinary concepts. You are confident in your craft, creative and organised, and you thrive just as much on leading a team through a busy service as you do on developing next season's menu.

• 

Hold a professional qualification as a chef, preferably with experience as a Sous Chef or in another kitchen leadership role

• 

Have a strong interest in locally sourced and sustainable food

• 

Be quality-conscious, organised and solution-oriented

• 

Be a team player who motivates others and creates a sense of confidence and security

• 

Be flexible and thrive in a fast-paced seasonal environment

• 

Have good communication skills in Norwegian or English

• 

Have experience working with fresh fish and shellfish

Lovund may be small on the map. Our ambitions are much bigger.

Would you like to make your mark on our kitchen? We would love to hear from you -- even if you are not actively looking for a new job today.

Send us a few words about yourself, your experience and what you dream of developing as a chef and leader.

Arbeidsoppgaver

• 

Contribute to menu planning and development in collaboration with the Head Chef

• 

Shift leader during evening service

• 

Preparation and production of dinners and banqueting

• 

Plan and coordinate the daily allocation of tasks

• 

Ensure quality control throughout food production

• 

Manage goods handling and stock control, including some ordering of supplies

• 

Supervise, support and train employees and apprentices

• 

Ensure smooth service and effective teamwork during service

• 

Maintain and develop strong health, safety and food hygiene routines, including HSE and food safety procedures

Vi tilbyr

• 

A key role in the development of the kitchen and culinary concept.

• 

The opportunity to work with high-quality ingredients sourced from the sea and the Helgeland coast.

• 

Responsibility and influence over day-to-day operations.

• 

A dedicated team with ambitions to create exceptional experiences for our guests and make the most of what the destination has to offer.

• 

Opportunities for professional development and assistance with accommodation by mutual agreement.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Lovund Hotell ligger spektakulært til ved havet på øya Lovund, midt i hjertet av Helgelandskysten. Vi er kjent for vår varme gjestfrihet, moderne uttrykk og høy kvalitet i både service og matopplevelse. Hotellets restaurant tilbyr nordnorsk matkultur med fokus på lokale råvarer fra hav og land, og vi jobber kontinuerlig med å løfte vårt kjøkken til nye høyder.
